regional_summary_6h.headline: Idlib ammunition blasts and Suweida militia clash dominate Syria threat picture
bullets: Syria dominates the window: a third Idlib ammunition-vehicle blast pushed the death toll to five, with eight earlier injured, alongside a reported clash between Syrian forces and the Al-Hijri militia in Suweida.
Iraq moved against the Hezbollah Brigades with sentences tied to the US embassy attack, sharpening militant-to-state pressure on a key cross-border actor.

Georgia and Armenia register lower-significance domestic stress — a Tbilisi migration custody case with Russia-deportation fears and the arrest of a former Armenian State Revenue Committee chairman in a bribery probe.
regional_summary_6h.watch: Idlib follow-on blasts and Suweida militia regrouping are the clearest escalation risk over the next window.
